title: 해양경비법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Notification Regarding Use and Operation within the Designated Area)
① Notifications required by Article 20(1) to (4) of this Act must be made 5 days prior to the implementation of any of the following:
1. Permission to use and occupy public waterways as defined in Article 8 of the "Waterway Management and Reclamation Act"
2. Implementation of a port development project as defined in Article 9(1) of the "Port Act"
3. Implementation of a harbor development project as defined in Article 23(1) of the "Fisheries and Harbors Act"
4. Fishing license as defined in Article 7 of the "Fisheries Act"
5. Aquaculture license as defined in Article 10 of the "Act on the Development of Aquaculture" (excluding aquaculture licenses as defined in Article 10(1)(7))
② Notifications required by Article 20(1) to (4) of this Act must include the following information:
1. Information related to personnel involved in the permission
2. Information related to the duration of the permission

Regarding the matters specified in items 3, 4, and 5:

3. Matters related to the location of permits, etc.
4. Matters that may disrupt maritime patrol activities due to permits, etc.
5. Other matters determined and announced by the Director-General of the Marine Police Agency related to the content of permits, etc.

③ The Director-General of the Marine Police Agency, the head of a local Marine Police Agency, or the head of a relevant Marine Police Station, upon receiving notification under items 1 and 2, may submit opinions or request necessary cooperation regarding the relevant permits, etc., if they deem it necessary. <Amended November 19, 2014, July 26, 2017>
